about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Suan Cai Bai Rou Northeastern Pickled Cabbage and Pork Pot
recipes.summary: A tangy Dongbei pot of pickled cabbage, pork belly slices and glass noodles that melt into a sour-savoury broth.
steps: Simmer the pork in the water with the ginger for 15 minutes until it turns opaque and firm.
Add the pickled cabbage, soy sauce and sugar and simmer 15 minutes until the cabbage is soft and the pork reaches 70°C.
Add the tofu and noodles and simmer 6 minutes until the noodles are tender and glassy.
Scatter with spring onions and serve from the pot.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork to at least 70°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hui Guo Rou Sichuan Twice-Cooked Pork with Leek
recipes.summary: Pork belly simmered, sliced and fried with leek and chilli bean paste until the edges curl.
steps: Simmer the pork in water for 30 minutes until a skewer slides in easily and the centre reaches 71°C, then cool and slice thinly.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Fry the pork slices in a dry wok for 5 minutes until the edges curl and the fat renders.
Push aside, add the oil, doubanjiang and garlic for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, sugar and leeks and toss 3 minutes until the leeks are just soft.
Spoon the pork and leeks over the rice and serve while the edges are still crisp.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork to at least 70°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Yangzhou Chao Fan Egg and Prawn Fried Rice
recipes.summary: Golden egg-coated rice with prawns, ham and peas, the banquet classic.
steps: Beat the eggs and scramble in 1 tbsp oil for 1 minute until just set, then set aside.
Heat the remaining oil in a wok and fry the rice for 4 minutes on high until it jumps and is piping hot.
Add the ham, prawns and peas and toss 3 minutes until heated through at 75°C.
Return the egg, add the soy sauce and spring onions and toss 1 minute.
notes: Food safety: use rice that was chilled within 1 hour of cooking, reheat until steaming hot, and cook the eggs until set. Contains egg and shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Jiu Cai He Zi Chive and Egg Pockets
recipes.summary: Pan-fried pastry pockets of garlic chives, egg and glass noodles.
steps: Mix the flour with the boiling water and 1/4 tsp salt, knead smooth and rest the dough 20 minutes covered.
Scramble the eggs until just set, soak the noodles in hot water until tender and chop, then mix both with the chives, sesame oil and soy sauce.
Roll the dough thin, cut 12cm rounds, fill, fold and crimp the edges closed.
Pan-fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until deep golden and the filling is hot at 75°C.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set and heat the filling to 75°C. Contains egg and gluten. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tie Ban Dou Fu Sizzling Hotplate Tofu
recipes.summary: Golden tofu sizzled with mushrooms and capsicum in a soy-ginger sauce; fully vegan.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Fry the tofu in 2 tbsp oil for 6 minutes until golden on both sides.
Add the mushrooms, capsicum and ginger and fry 4 minutes until soft.
Stir the soy sauce, sugar, cornflour and 3 tbsp water and add, simmering 2 minutes until glossy.
Serve sizzling over the rice.

recipes.title: Jia Chang Dou Fu Home-Style Braised Tofu
recipes.summary: Golden pan-fried tofu simmered with pork, carrot and peas in a savoury sauce.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Fry the tofu in 2 tbsp oil for 6 minutes until golden and set aside.
Fry the pork and garlic in the remaining oil for 5 minutes until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C.
Add the carrot, soy sauce, oyster sauce and water and simmer 6 minutes, return the tofu and add the peas.
Thicken with the cornflour stirred in 1 tbsp water for 1 minute and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince to 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Shao Qie Zi Claypot Braised Eggplant with Mince
recipes.summary: Soft eggplant simmered in a garlicky mince sauce in a clay pot.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Fry the eggplant in 3 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until golden and set aside.
Fry the pork, garlic and doubanjiang in the remaining oil for 5 minutes until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, water and eggplant and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes until soft.
Thicken with the cornflour stirred in 1 tbsp water, scatter with spring onions and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince to 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sha Guo Dou Fu Claypot Tofu with Prawns and Mushrooms
recipes.summary: Silky tofu and prawns simmered in a ginger broth in a clay pot.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Bring the stock, ginger, soy sauce and oyster sauce to a simmer in a clay pot until fragrant.
Add the mushrooms and tofu and simmer 6 minutes.
Add the prawns and bok choy and cook 3 minutes until the prawns are pink and opaque.
Finish with the sesame oil and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque, at least 63°C inside. Contains shellfish and soy. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ma Yi Shang Shu Ants Climbing a Tree Pork Noodles
recipes.summary: Glass noodles with spicy minced pork that clings like ants on a tree.
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water for 8 minutes until pliable, then drain.
Fry the garlic, ginger and doubanjiang in the oil for 1 minute, then add the pork and cook 5 minutes until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C.
Add the stock and soy sauce, then the noodles, and simmer 5 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Scatter with spring onions and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince to 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pidan Shou Rou Zhou Century Egg and Pork Congee
recipes.summary: Silky rice porridge with century egg and pork, topped with ginger and spring onion.
steps: Rinse the rice and simmer it with the water and ginger for 50 minutes, stirring now and then, until the grains collapse into a thick porridge.
Stir in the pork and cook 5 minutes until no pink remains and it reaches 71°C.
Add the century eggs, soy sauce and sesame oil and warm for 2 minutes.
Serve in bowls topped with spring onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork to at least 70°C. Use century eggs from a trusted source and keep them chilled. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dan Hua Zhou Egg Drop Congee with Mushrooms
recipes.summary: Comforting egg ribbon porridge with shiitake and ginger.
steps: Rinse the rice and simmer it with the water and ginger for 40 minutes until the grains collapse into porridge.
Add the mushrooms and cook 5 minutes until soft.
Beat the eggs and stream them in while stirring so they form ribbons, cooking 1 minute until set.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and top with spring onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hong Kong Prawn and Egg Scramble Rice Plate
recipes.summary: Silky eggs with prawns, spring onion and a splash of soy over rice.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Fry the prawns in 1 tbsp oil for 2 minutes until pink and curled, then set aside.
Beat the eggs with the wine and a pinch of salt and scramble in the remaining oil for 1 minute until barely set.
Fold in the prawns and spring onion and cook 30 seconds until the egg is set with no liquid remaining.
Spoon over the rice and drizzle with soy sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque, at least 63°C inside, and the eggs until set. Contains egg and shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sizzling Black Pepper Beef Hotplate Cantonese Style
recipes.summary: Beef strips and onion in a glossy black pepper sauce, served sizzling with rice.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Sear the beef in 1 tbsp very hot oil for 2 minutes per batch until browned and at least 71°C.
Fry the onions and capsicum in the remaining oil for 4 minutes.
Stir the oyster sauce, soy sauce, pepper, cornflour and water together, add and simmer 2 minutes until glossy.
Return the beef, toss and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hong Kong Soy Sauce Chicken with Ginger Oil Rice
recipes.summary: Whole chicken poached in a soy and spice liquid until glossy, served with ginger-scented rice.
steps: Bring the soy sauces, wine, sugar, star anise, ginger slices and water to a boil in a pot just large enough for the chicken until the sugar dissolves.
Lower the chicken in, cover and simmer very gently for 35 minutes, turning once, until the thickest part reaches 75°C.
Rest 15 minutes, then chop. Cook the rice until tender and fluffy in some strained braising liquid and water.
Heat the oil, pour over the grated ginger and a pinch of salt and spoon over the rice.
Serve the chicken with the rice and a little braising liquid.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C at the thickest part of the thigh. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Gu Lao Ji Pineapple Sweet and Sour Chicken
recipes.summary: Crisp chicken pieces in a bright sweet and sour sauce with pineapple and capsicum.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Toss the chicken in the egg, then the cornflour, and fry in the oil for 6 minutes in batches until golden and 75°C in the centre.
Simmer the tomato sauce, vinegar, sugar and soy sauce for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Toss in the pineapple and capsicum for 1 minute, add the chicken to coat and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C in the centre. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Jiang Cong Yu Cantonese Ginger and Spring Onion Fish
recipes.summary: Steamed white fish dressed with sizzling oil, ginger, spring onion and soy.

items: 4 spring onions, cut into fine strips

steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Steam the fish with the wine on a heatproof plate for 8 minutes until opaque and flaking at 63°C.
Pour off the liquid and top the fish with half the ginger and spring onion.
Heat the oil until smoking, pour it over the topping to sizzle, then add the soy sauce.
Serve with the rice and the remaining spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C. Contains fish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Luo Bo Niu Nam Daikon and Beef Brisket Claypot
recipes.summary: Brisket and radish slow-braised in an aromatic soy broth.
steps: Blanch the brisket in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and rinse.
Simmer the brisket in a clay pot with the water, ginger, star anise, soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar for 90 minutes until tender and at least 71°C.
Add the daikon and simmer 25 minutes until translucent and soft.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, scatter the stew with spring onions and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ge Zai Yu Fish and Tofu Claypot with Ginger
recipes.summary: White fish and silken tofu in a ginger broth with mushrooms and greens.

items: 500g white fish fillet, cut into chunks

steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Bring the water, ginger and mushrooms to a simmer in the pot until fragrant, about 8 minutes.
Add the tofu, fish and soy sauce and simmer gently for 6 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes at 63°C.
Add the bok choy for 1 minute, finish with sesame oil and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C. Contains fish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
